snippet.title: Astro Colony - 1.0 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
After 3.5 years in Early Access, Astro Colony is finally ready for the 1.0 release!

The game will be released June 2, 2026, alongside a new update.

Astro Colony game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1614550/Astro_Colony/

We hope you will join our Discord community to share your feedback!
https://discord.com/invite/EFzAA3w

#steam #astrocolony #gamerelease
